text:
emma.engineering: Heads up — main dashboard charts are super slow after the canary rolled (deploy 2024-04-12). FCP for chart-heavy views jumped from ~1.8s to ~7.2s :grimacing:
noah.platform: seeing this too, metric pane takes 6-9s to render on EU canary
olivia-sre: any errors in console or network waterfall?
emma.engineering: console shows long parse/compile times and repeated requests to /static/visualization/chunk-... js with 200s; also observed duplicate bundle downloads
liam-ux: users reporting janky interactions on hover
raj: could this be the telemetry probe change that made a large inline import? rolled in last canary
emma.engineering: suspecting bundle duplication + kv-prefetch misses causing rehydration thrash
noah.platform: quick check — payloads: large main bundle + telemetry chunk increased ~120KB gzip
emma.engineering: minimal repro: open dashboard->run heavy query->chart stalls
emma.engineering: curl snippet from the client to show repeated chunk fetches:
```http
GET /static/chunks/visual-plot.9f3a2.js 200 49KB
GET /static/chunks/visual-plot.9f3a2.js 200 49KB
GET /api/v1/metrics?range=1h 200 2.1MB
```
olivia-sre: can someone check routing policy/service that serves chunk CDN header? maybe cache-control changed
noah.platform: checked edge logs — several requests have Cache-Control: private, max-age=0 for that chunk since 1718200000
raj: that's from the telemetry proxy update — we added dynamic source maps fetching, might've accidentally turned off immutable headers for split chunks
liam-ux: if chunks are re-downloading we get expensive parse on main thread — explains FCP bump
emma.engineering: suggestion: revert telemetry proxy header tweak in canary + re-run, or patch to set immutable for content-hash chunks
olivia-sre: I'll open a rollback PR for the proxy tweak and can trigger a canary redeploy
noah.platform: also worth looking at KV cache keys — plumbed kvcache affinity changes last week
raj: kv-affinity change was to reduce hot shard but could increase cache misses for small routes
emma.engineering: can we short-circuit: set Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable on hashed client chunks; leave telemetry bundle as before
olivia-sre: agreed. doing rollback first to confirm causality
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback/telemetry-proxy-header-fix (canary)
liam-ux: also can we add a small UX fallback: show skeletons and throttle render until chunks available to avoid main-thread jank
emma.engineering: good idea — I'll prototype quick debounce for chart mount to avoid serial parsing spike
noah.platform: after rollback can we collect trace (Lighthouse + RUM) to compare? need before/after numbers
emma.engineering: yes saving traces now. will post artifacts
olivia-sre: rollback completed. canary back at previous artifact
noah.platform: initial numbers look promising — FCP back down to ~2s for same workload
raj: opening small follow-up to set proper headers and audit other proxies
emma.engineering: thanks all. follow-up checklist: 1) audit split-chunk headers 2) review kvcache-affinity telemetry interaction 3) small chart debounce PR 4) add canary perf smoke test
liam-ux: tagging PM for UX impact: @product-lead
emma.engineering: +1. will file ticket with traces
noah.platform: thx — will monitor metrics for 24h
olivia-sre: marking incident as mitigated for now :white_check_mark:
